pages.title: Pages and Notebooks
pages.text: Paper becomes an Empty Page. Leather and two Empty Pages make a Notebook, which stores up to 56 ordered Symbol Pages and may be named in its own screen.

pages.title: The Book Binder
pages.text: The Binder combines leather with loose symbols or a filled Notebook to make a Descriptive Book. Leather alone makes a blank Descriptive Book; add one Empty Page instead to bind a Linking Book.

pages.title: Ink and Authorship
pages.text: Ink Vials are used by the Writing Desk and curse cleansing. The Desk copies a Notebook into an unlinked Descriptive Book and renames descriptive bindings.

pages.title: Editing and Printing
pages.text: The Editing Table tunes an unlinked book or cleanses a linked one. The Printing Table turns a Notebook symbol into a loose page, or duplicates a linked book.

pages.title: Displaying Books
pages.text: Use a Linking Book or Descriptive Book on an empty Bookstand to display it. Use the stand normally to read or activate the book; crouch-use it to take the book back. Breaking the stand also returns its book.

pages.title: Portal Receptacles
pages.text: A Book Receptacle replaces one Crystal in a portal frame and holds the linked book that powers it. Crystal itself has no ordinary recipe: recover it from crystal formations, tendrils, and certain obelisks with an iron pickaxe or better.

pages.title: The Primer
pages.text: The Wayfarer's Primer is crafted directly from leather and three Empty Pages. Patchouli is optional for the mod, but must be installed for this item to open the illustrated guide.
